answer: Sybil resistance can rest on sibling collision: the seed sorts applicants into cohorts of eight, each draft compared with its seven neighbors. Duplicate neighbors are voided together, both posters forfeiting bond: a clone is a liability, not a spare ticket. Ten puppets on one prompt converge, then fall together, so each identity needs separate reasoning at ten times the price. The velvet glove is that this rule is published first. The trellis is the cohort grid keeping checks local. The cipher is the seed, sealed until the epoch opens, so colluders cannot pre-sort into safe groups.
